Authenticate with either an `Authorization` bearer JWT or an `AccessKey` header.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:

Must fall within the 3-day log retention window. The total range
(`To - From`) cannot exceed 3 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the time range (UTC). Defaults to `now`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of HTTP status filters. Each entry can be an exact
code (e.g. `200`, `404`) or a status class (e.g. `2xx`, `5xx`).
Multiple entries are combined with OR.

parameters.name: cacheStatus
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of cache statuses to match exactly (e.g. `HIT,MISS,EXPIRED`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. `EE`). Multiple values can be comma-separated.

parameters.name: edgeLocation
parameters.description: Edge location / server zone (exact match).

parameters.name: remoteIp
parameters.description:
Client IP address filter (IPv4 or IPv6). The match width adapts to the zone's
IP anonymization setting so the filter can never reveal information beyond
what the API returns: exact match when anonymization is disabled, /24 (IPv4)
or /64 (IPv6) when last-octet anonymization is enabled, and ignored when full
anonymization is enabled.

parameters.name: urlContains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the request URL (host + path).

parameters.name: userAgentContains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the User-Agent header.

parameters.name: refererContains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the Referer header.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
Free-text, case-insensitive token search. Tokens are space-separated; a row
matches if ANY token appears in ANY of the searched columns: cache status,
request ID, edge location, host, path, user agent, referer, and (for zones
with extended logging) content range. Remote IP, country code, and the
authorization header are not searched. use the dedicated filters for those,
or note that the authorization header is encrypted at rest. Limited to 16
tokens of at most 128 characters each.

parameters.name: requestId

parameters.name: includeOriginShield
parameters.description: Include origin-shield (edge → shield) requests. Defaults to `false` to match v1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 100. Capped at 10000.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of entries to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: order
